resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR data box and Wikipedia give 13 ft (4 m); NHLR text says 15 ft above sea level. The story gives both figures.

The NHLR page's Registry Numbers field lists US 567 and NJ 20. These are NHLR registry identifiers, not highway routes, so they do not conflict. The 1968 state bid notice places the tower on Route 47, and the story attributes Route 47 to that notice.

sources.title: List of New Jersey Forest Fire Service fire towers

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR gives the 1944 build year. A web search snippet (a lookout database, firelookout.org, not reachable: 404) gave 1945 and NJ Mosquito Commission ownership; not opened or cited, so not in the story. Staffing and access are not documented beyond the undated 'put back into service' statement. Route 47 comes only from the 1968 bid notice; the NHLR 'US 567 / NJ 20' entries are registry numbers, not highway routes. Brief record elevation 4.0 m and height 30 m are consistent with sources; no corrections.
